content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen reads cleanly in the right order, but the radiator illustration takes a large dead band and the page repeats the phone number and address three times (hero, CTA, footer).","desktopNote":"Desktop hero is a solid two-column layout with a distinctive pipe motif, yet the oversized centred logo header and the lone 'Domov' nav waste space, and the services grid leaves an empty cell.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Replace or reduce the giant centred header logo and single-link nav with a compact header, and merge the 'Pokličite nas za ogled' block with the footer contact so phone/address appear once beyond the hero.","Add a real job photo (bathroom, boiler room) alongside or instead of the radiator illustration, and fill the empty sixth service cell or switch to a three-column grid.","Keep the pipe divider between sections but tighten the dead space above and below it, especially on phone where the illustration pushes 'Kaj delamo' far down."],"blockers":["Desktop 'Kje delamo': 'Slovenska Bistrica' and 'okolica Maribora' wrap onto a second line that is cut off at the slice edge, breaking the city row."]}
